judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a specification file (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), a definition-of-done document (`.lore/dod.md`), and three failing acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`. It never actually implemented the feature in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or added `ajv` to `package.json`, meaning the added tests will fail immediately. Furthermore, most of the required unit tests, orchestrator loop tests, and documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) are completely missing. The spec file itself is very close to the reference, which is the only overlap.
